posts.title: Profunctor Learners
posts.description: Optics have a very nice formulation used in some Haskell (and PureScript !) libraries; the so-called “profunctor representation”. Learners, defined a certain way , look an awful lot like some kind of two-sided or symmetric optic. Let’s see if we can devise a profunctor representation for them. This post was prompted by a chat with Bartosz Milewski . > Read Post
